prompt: What could a green tie tell a resident who is choosing where to pick?
promptZh: 住戶在挑選採摘位置時，綠帶能告訴他什麼？

options.text: Every pear on that branch is ready to eat.
options.zh: 那一枝上的每顆梨都可以吃了。

options.text: No one has picked any fruit from that branch.
options.zh: 那一枝還沒人摘過果實。
options.whyZh: 綠帶只表示已盤點，不表示之後是否有人摘過。

options.text: The branch may be picked from even if it is high above the ground.
options.zh: 即使枝條在高處，也可以從那一枝摘。
options.whyZh: 採摘僅限綁綠帶的低枝；高枝不開放住戶採摘。

options.text: If it is a low branch, it is one of the branches from which picking is allowed.
options.zh: 如果是低枝，就屬於可以採摘的枝條。
options.whyZh: 低枝且有綠帶即可採摘，但仍受完成盤點前每戶上限約束。

explanationZh: 低枝且有綠帶即可採摘，但仍受完成盤點前每戶上限約束。
evidence: You may pick only from low branches with a green tie. / The ties show only which branches were counted; they say nothing about whether individual pears are ripe.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You may pick only from low branches with a green tie.
The ties show only which branches were counted; they say nothing about whether individual pears are ripe.

vocabulary.term: at the base of a branch
vocabulary.zh: 在枝條靠近樹幹的位置
vocabulary.note: base 是枝條開始延伸出去的一端。
